subject: Error: record date outside camera operation date range:

messages.author: 8af46ba51a35c5cd
messages.subject: Error: record date outside camera operation date range:
parts:
To whom ever can help, 

I am trying to get the detection history for a species, but continue to get the following error:

Error: record date outside camera operation date range:  BB5, DA1, DA2, DA5, OL10, OL11, OL6, WM2

Where could the problem be? 

Thank you in advance!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error: record date outside camera operation date range:
parts:
Hi,
this error means that there is a mismatch between the dates of your camera trap records and the camera trap operation dates. Check if the camera trap setup and retrieval dates are correct. Often it is simply a typo, e.g. wrong year. You can also use the function camOpPlot which is in the vignette to visualise the active camera trapping period and find outliers:
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/vignettes/DataExtraction.html#camera-operation

Let me know if the problem persists.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error: record date outside camera operation date range:
parts: Update: the problem was caused by the argument dateFormat in the function cameraOperation() being specified incorrectly.
